frame: local metric xyz; z is an arbitrary relative vertical datum; negative domain z is not underground terrain
continuity: C-infinity analytical prescribed flow; native piecewise-constant cell-centre sampling is explicitly part of the simulator approximation.
physical_interpretation: Steady open-boundary shear-advection field with modest upward flow. Kinematically divergence-free with balanced net face flux; not a Navier-Stokes/CFD solution and not measured weather. No lakeshore, thermal or turbulent-flow fidelity claim.

native_wind_recipe.format: little-endian int32 major=3, minor=0 followed by xyz float32 triplets

calibration_inputs: Only analytic constants and declared grids; no plume, source labels, posterior or trial outcomes.
future_readback_gate: Before any simulation use the actual native decoder to prove header/dimensions/order, all finite vectors and byte-equivalent data; actual generator/libgaden/source hashes must match the recorded intended runtime. Do not substitute zero wind.
